title: Red Streak Reversion
summary: After at least n consecutive red sessions, how often the next one closed green. The denominator is sessions immediately preceded by a red run of length n or more; the numerator is the ones that closed above their open. 'Due for a bounce' is exactly the claim this lets you check instead of assume — compare against the baseline green rate, and expect N to shrink fast as n grows, which is what the guards are for.

params.name: n
params.doc: Minimum length of the preceding red streak.

deltas: n is a parameter — every streak length is one run, not one report
open-to-close return distribution shows size, not just direction
N + 95% CI + guards make thin long-streak samples visibly thin
